description: Zones inondables selon un aléa de forte probabilité sur le TRI Nevers - Nièvre (58) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by donnees.centre.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Table of floodable surfaces (area that will be flooded in the event of a flood of a certain type under a certain scenario). Spatial data set produced by the GIS High Flood Risk Land Flood Directive (TRI) of... and mapped for reporting purposes for the European Flood Directive. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Flooding zones according to a high probability hazard on the TRI Nevers — Nièvre (58)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. The listing shows 2020-08-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
